"""Scatter: Top-5% concentration vs MCKP improvement for 5 models."""
import matplotlib
matplotlib.use('Agg')
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import os

plt.rcParams.update({
    'font.family': 'DejaVu Sans',
    'font.size': 11,
    'axes.titlesize': 13,
    'axes.labelsize': 12,
    'xtick.labelsize': 10,
    'ytick.labelsize': 10,
    'figure.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.dpi': 300,
    'savefig.bbox': 'tight',
    'savefig.pad_inches': 0.05,
    'axes.spines.top': False,
    'axes.spines.right': False,
})

OUT_DIR = '/root/ratekv/figures'

data = [
    ('Gemma-2-9B',      0.223,  -0.024, '#009E73'),
    ('Mistral-7B-v0.3', 0.231,  -0.432, '#CC79A7'),
    ('Llama-3.1-8B',    0.575,   0.019, '#0072B2'),
    ('Yi-1.5-9B',       0.714,  -0.096, '#E69F00'),
    ('Qwen2.5-7B',      0.616,   4.214, '#D55E00'),
]

offsets = {
    'Gemma-2-9B':      (0.02, 0.30),
    'Mistral-7B-v0.3': (0.02, -0.35),
    'Llama-3.1-8B':    (-0.02, 0.35),
    'Yi-1.5-9B':       (-0.02, 0.30),
    'Qwen2.5-7B':      (0.02, -0.55),
}

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(7, 4.5))

for name, conc, delta, color in data:
    ax.scatter(conc, delta, s=100, color=color, edgecolor='black', linewidth=0.8, zorder=5)
    ox, oy = offsets[name]
    ha = 'right' if ox < 0 else 'left'
    ax.annotate(name, (conc, delta),
                xytext=(conc + ox, delta + oy),
                fontsize=9.5, color=color, fontweight='bold', ha=ha,
                arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle='-', color='#aaaaaa', lw=0.6))

ax.axhline(y=0, color='#999999', linestyle='--', linewidth=1, zorder=1)
ax.axvline(x=0.50, color='#CC0000', linestyle=':', linewidth=1.2, zorder=1, alpha=0.7)
ax.text(0.507, 2.5, 'c = 0.50', fontsize=8.5, color='#CC0000', alpha=0.8, style='italic')

ax.set_xlabel('Top-5% Concentration')
ax.set_ylabel('MCKP Improvement (Δ PPL)')
ax.set_title('Concentration vs. MCKP Benefit (Budget = 0.25)')

for fmt in ['pdf', 'png']:
    out = os.path.join(OUT_DIR, f'fig_concentration_scatter.{fmt}')
    fig.savefig(out, bbox_inches='tight', dpi=300)
    print(f'Saved {out}')
plt.close(fig)
PYEOF
